title: Airspeed Indicator
description: An aircraft airspeed indicator with colored arcs and a red line. The needle follows a live reading and turns red on overspeed.

title: Battery Pack Charge
description: State of charge, current, temperature and all eight cells live while a LiFePO4 pack charges and balances.

title: Power Rails Fixture
description: A board drawing whose test points light up as the probe moves, each turning green or red with its rail's result.

title: Motor Spin Test
description: Speed and current arc gauges for a drone motor and ESC, with each throttle setpoint lit as the sweep reaches it.
